name: Demon Flesh, Lesser
body:
School abjuration [evil]; Level cleric/oracle 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF/M (small amount of flesh of a demon)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 min./level or until discharged
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

The creature touched gains damage reduction 5/cold iron and good for the duration of the spell. Once the spell has prevented a total of 10 points of damage per caster level (maximum 100 points), it is discharged.
